stage_order: A forensic complete before any new training
B selected base window/target: L1/L2 tail experts and fixed risk gates
C direct raw/log remaining, no-total-feature, no-elapsed ablation
backend: CPU4 across all folds and final; no GPU trial needed, CPU inference1

total.window_key: submit_time within latest D days before TRAIN cutoff; exact completion known before same cutoff
total.relative: log((T+1)/(requested_seconds+1)); V8 exact transform; missing walltime uses TRAIN-median walltime denominator
total.mappings: fit only to each window TRAIN descriptor support; deterministic category sort; unknown0
total.censoring: direct quantiles trained on exact completed labels only; report censored exclusions and maturity-selection limitation
total.selection: First select one of15 base models, then compare5 unique gated candidates on selected base. No exhaustive target/window/weight interactions. Eligibility first; if none, fewest failed gates then rank; diagnostic only.

weights.L2: 4 if T>12h else2 if T>4h else1

tail.classifier_validation: meaningful discrimination plus pooled Brier skill>0 and recall_at_fixed_threshold>=.50; raw probability bins10, no probability recalibration

total.order_repair: Q50=max(Q50,0);Q90=max(Q90,Q50,0); no walltime cap or global multiplier

remaining.window: selected TOTAL window, no new window search
remaining.diagnostic_ablation: R3_NO_ELAPSED same TRAIN rows/window/params, not eligible
remaining.checkpoint: start+1800*k strictly before observed completion; no postcompletion rows
remaining.train: completed labels known before TRAIN cutoff only; every checkpoint, unit row weight; censored remaining targets not fabricated
remaining.split: Episode identity assigned by inherited submit-time role before checkpoint expansion; disjoint within each fold. Earlier VALID can causally enter later expanding TRAIN after completion, not within-fold leakage.
remaining.selection: eligible first, then remaining Q90 pinball,Q50 MAE,fold std; if none, fewest failed gates then rank; raw/log only
remaining.classification: remaining Q90>threshold, as V9/V10; not a0.5 probability classifier

overrun: RUNNING retains GPU; recompute at each30min checkpoint/control extension; extend exactly900s when expired; STAY; never terminate
queue: V9 empty-background bounded preApril forecast ledger and separately labeled causal stress; remaining calls receive only request descriptors and observed elapsed, completion observer isolated
final_fit: same final V9 TRAIN cutoff2025-03-17T08Z, available2025-03-31T08Z; no CAL outcome adaptation, all frozen through April

forensic.PSI: TRAIN decile edges, probabilities epsilon1e-6 only descriptive metric
forensic.conditional: exact raw descriptor cells with TRAIN>=50 VALID>=30; report common-support mass, weighted within-cell KS and prevalence changes; no proof solely from marginals
forensic.recency: Compare recent30d TRAIN label CDF distance to VALID vs expanding; descriptive only, model family/window set unchanged
